name: programmatic-seo
description: For programmatic SEO: template pages built from a dataset, such as location pages (a page per city) or a page per tool, integration or product; not programmatic advertising. Checks from your rows which entries have enough facts of their own to deserve a page and which should share one, specifies the page template, checks pasted sample pages for duplicate content and thin content, and plans a batched launch, saying from your batch numbers whether to continue or pause. It does not write the pages or estimate search volume.
